name: ByteRover
ontology_notes: Canonical public repo found: campfirein/byterover-cli (formerly Cipher), homepage docs.byterover.dev. V4 product is Desktop + spaces + a skill (bind, query, record, dream, auth). Structured records use bv-topic with bv-task, bv-decision, bv-reason, bv-fact, and implied rules/files. This is project knowledge for coding agents, not companion memory. V4 ranking internals inside Desktop/cloud are not fully specified in the public docs.

ontology.evidence: docs v4/skill/record.md structured HTML: bv-topic, bv-task, bv-decision, bv-reason, bv-fact with subject/category/value. Context tree of topics. Not user/character/relationship.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Record skill. Agent writes after useful work. Docs say do not record facts obvious from source. User can ask to record or update. Dream does not write; merge/prune/synthesize scripts do after review.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Query skill before non-trivial work. query.mjs returns ranked hits with path, title, score, snippet, should_cite, citation_block. Agent may skip query. Retrieve-nothing is documented (if nothing useful appears, continue).
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Record can update an existing topic. Dream merge folds one topic into another and removes the loser. prune removes stale topics. Dream itself only proposes.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Public V4 docs do not describe validity windows or last-Tuesday queries. Topics can go stale (Dream prune) without a time index being named.
temporal.label: inferred

identity_split.evidence: Spaces (private, team, shared) and project bind. No user vs character vs relationship. Memory is project knowledge.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Query ranks by relevance. No control to suppress a high-score topic for social reasons.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Recorded HTML is later retrieved as constraints. No trust tags or jailbreak filter in V4 skill docs.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: prune.mjs deletes topics after Dream review. No user forget-that. Dream prune is proposal-only until the agent runs prune.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: V4 docs do not state LLM/embed calls per query. Query is a script returning JSON hits. Extract cost of record/dream is not published.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: CLI is source-available Elastic-2.0 (cannot offer it as a hosted service). V4 quick start requires Desktop sign-in (Google or GitHub) to load spaces. Intimate companion chat is not the product.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: CLI README historically described MCP for the Cipher-era product. V4 docs index is skill-based (npx skills add campfirein/skills), not an official MCP memory server.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Coding-agent project memory. Context tree and decisions, not a companion. ELv2 and V4 account spaces. Use as a negative control next to claude-mem.

published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: paper/ exists in the CLI repo; no companion or LoCoMo score cited in V4 docs fetched.

open_unknowns: How V4 Query ranks hits (vector vs keyword vs tree) is not in the public skill docs.
Whether Cipher-era MCP still ships in current byterover-cli.
paper/ contents were not opened this session.
